rows.corpus_definition: To show deep respect or love for a god or spirit.
rows.example_en: They go to the temple to worship every Sunday.

rows.corpus_definition: a small line or fold that forms in skin or cloth
rows.example_en: She noticed a wrinkle on her forehead in the mirror.

rows.corpus_definition: A system of physical poses and breathing to relax the body.
rows.example_en: I practice yoga every morning to reduce stress.

rows.corpus_definition: a place where young people go for fun activities and to meet friends
rows.example_en: I go to the youth club every Friday night.

rows.corpus_definition: to say that someone did something wrong or broke the law
rows.example_en: They did not accuse him of the crime.

rows.corpus_definition: To be used to something or someone.
rows.example_en: I am accustomed to the cold weather.

rows.corpus_definition: To finish something successfully after much effort.
rows.example_en: She worked hard to achieve her life goals.

rows.corpus_definition: To accept that something is true or exists.
rows.example_en: She did not acknowledge my greeting.

rows.corpus_definition: to help someone get to know another person or thing
rows.example_en: Let me acquaint you with the new office rules.

rows.corpus_definition: to get or gain something, especially through effort or experience
rows.example_en: She acquired new skills during her time abroad.
